headline: On October 13, 2010: 33 Chilean miners rescued after 69 days
captionCards: Rescue mission set a survival record
instagramCaption:
The San José mine in Chile collapses. \\[A cave-in trapped 33 miners 700 meters underground for 69 days. The rescue operation, watched by millions, brought all the miners to safety on October 13, 2010. This event set a record for the longest time survived underground after a mining accident. It remains a symbol of resilience and international cooperation. \\What do you think was the most challenging part of the rescue? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
